transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the pre-movement load-planning review started. We've got one heavy trailer with front, center, and rear positions to fill with the communications shelter, water tank module, and generator module. Convoy departs at 1600 tomorrow. I need each of you to report any updates from your lane — the loadmaster, route liaison, and maintenance chief. Remember, under the movement-control procedure, any changed measurement, placement requirement, or maintenance status needs to be entered as a formal fact-update on the movement board. Verbal mentions alone won't update the board, and I'll be verifying all entries before we approve. Let's hear from each lane.
